{{Quote|They've told Palps to kiss their collective shebse.|[[Mij Gilamar]] on the Gibadan Parliament's response to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] ultimatum|<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
The '''Gibadan Parliament''' was the ruling body on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gibad/Legends|Gibad]].<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], they refused to cooperate with the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were given a deadline by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to stand down and when they did not, Palpatine unleashed a deadly [[FG36|virus]] created by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]], who was a native of the planet.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />
